messages:
janet_cust: hey @support, heads up — since the 09:15 deploy our prod consumer hitting /v1/generate (json-mode) started throwing parse errors. Previously returned strict JSON, now our parser fails with 'Unexpected token /' on first char. Reprobed with the same request id and got different body.

ashley: thanks @janet_cust — can you paste a minimal failing response and the request-id + model param you used? also any latency spikes? :eyes:

janet_cust: request-id=ri_2026_1015_42, model=request: "redwood-infer-llama-large:json-mode", route=/generate. Latency spiked ~200ms before the failure. here's the exact raw body we received (copied from tcpdump):

```
// TRACE: routed to variant=redwood-llama-q4f-v2 (fallback due to capacity)
// TRACE_ID: 2026-10-15T09:15:42Z
{"items": [{"id": "abc123", "result": {"name": "Widget", "qty": 3}}]}
```

ashley: whoa — looks like there are leading comment lines (// ...) before the JSON. Our consumers assume strict JSON and choke. did the client/server add tracing lines?

ops-bot: deploy-event: autoscaler triggered fallback pool: "q4f-pool-2" -> routing policy applied: SMART_FALLBACK. Variant mapped: redwood-llama-q4f-v2.

ingrid: tagging eng-ml — this is likely the smart routing wrapper adding trace preamble for that quantized variant. we added lightweight trace annotations to some variants for debugging but that should not alter bytes for json-mode responses. cc @maya

maya: re-assigning to eng-runtime and eng-ml, marking P2. @ingrid can you confirm if the variant binary emits trace comments at stdout-level vs metadata header? we need to stop inserting any non-json prefixes for structured outputs. :pray:

ingrid: quick root-cause notes: some older quantized kernels route output through a shim that prefixes a few lines for internal tracing when DEBUG_TRACES=1. fallback policy inadvertently enables this shim on q4f-v2. shim writes lines beginning with '//' to the response stream before streaming JSON chunks.

ashley: thanks for the explanation. customer impact: blocking production consumers. is there a hotfix or a customer workaround?

ingrid: short-term workaround: set header "X-Allow-Alternate-Variants: false" or in the create call set query param "strict_variant_match=true" to force the original variant. Also in Console you can disable "smart_fallback" per-route. we'll push a hotfix to strip trace preambles for structured response modes.

janet_cust: workaround applied (strict_variant_match=true) and parsing resumed. thank you. would like ETA on hotfix and a remediation so we don't have to pin variants forever.

maya: ETA: patch scheduled in the release containing runtime-2026-10-15-hotfix1, rolling deploy in ~90 minutes. we'll also add a compatibility test to ensure any fallback variant preserves exact leading bytes for json-mode.

ashley: collecting logs & sample bodies, creating support ticket SUP-11247 and linking to eng runtime PR once created. @janet_cust — can you share a short window where you saw the issue so we can correlate traces?

janet_cust: window 09:14:50-09:16:00 UTC. I'll DM the request payload and sample consumer logs.

ingrid: follow-ups: 1) add unit test that fails on any non-whitespace bytes preceding JSON root for structured modes, 2) change fallback policy to prefer variants with identical output-mode labels, 3) add telemetry so we emit a routed_variant header instead of in-body traces.

maya: noted, will prioritize the output-mode invariant checks. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:

ashley: marking thread resolved for now since customer has a workaround and hotfix queued. will reopen if new failures pop up.
